title: BPS lumps in the Nonminimal $CP^1$ Maxwell-Chern-Simons Model
summary: We investigate self-dual radially symmetric configurations in the $CP^1$ model coupled to a Maxwell and Chern-Simons (CS) gauge fields through nonminimal interactions. Starting from the nonlinear $O(3)$-sigma model, we explicitly construct its classical mapping to the $CP^1$ formulation, highlighting the emergence of a local $U(1)$ gauge symmetry intrinsically associated with the Fubini-Study geometry of the target space.
